evidence.custodyNote: The mandate custodies collateral and holds its own Perpl account; the agent can only trade through execPerplOrder (perps) or executeSwap (spot), both bounded on-chain. A breach reverts before any funds move — unit-tested in test/MandateExecution.t.sol (19/19 pass, incl. execPerplOrder LeverageExceeded). The mobile app deploys a user-owned custody mandate and routes manual trades through it, reading positions/PnL on-chain (app/lib/trade.ts).

appMandate.note: Mandate whose agent is the Charter app's passkey account. The mobile app simulates the agent proposing a trade (gas-free eth_call); a 3.00x long reverts LeverageExceeded (shown as 'Refused by your mandate'), a 1.50x long is allowed. See app/lib/mandate.ts.
